title: Cookie without SameSite Attribute
description: A cookie has been set without the SameSite attribute, which means that the cookie can be sent as a result of a 'cross-site' request.

verification.notes: Scanner alert initialized; pending verification evaluation

ai_advisory.gemma_explanation: A vulnerability has been identified due to the absence of SameSite attribute in a cookie. This allows cross-site request attacks, where malicious scripts can be injected into the session.
ai_advisory.remediation_advice: Set the SameSite attribute to 'strict' on the cookie to prevent cross-site requests.
ai_advisory.risk_summary: High risk, as cross-site request attacks can be used to gain unauthorized access to the system.
ai_advisory.recommendation: Ensure that the SameSite attribute is set to 'lax' or 'strict' for all sensitive cookies.
